sentences.text: The genus contains only one known species, Vectocleidus pastorum.
Benson and colleagues described the genus in 2012.
Fossils were found in the late Barremian stage of the Early Cretaceous Vectis Formation on the Isle of Wight, United Kingdom.
Taxonomists place Vectocleidus within the family Leptocleididae.
The animal belongs to the suborder Pliosauroidea.
This creature lived during the Early Cretaceous period.
It existed between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago during the Barremian stage.
